scope: Validate gRPC server TLS material before database pool creation

configuration.error_output: Fixed redacted messages; filesystem paths and provider exception text are not returned.

cases.missing_certificate_or_key: Rejected with a fixed redacted error before database pool creation.
cases.credential_construction_failure: Exception class is retained; exception details are redacted and the pool is not opened.
cases.valid_pair: Synthetic key/certificate bytes are passed to the gRPC credential factory before the pool and transport.

data_access.database_pool: Mock only; asserted unopened on invalid configuration.

limitations: The valid credential factory and transport startup use mocks; no certificate handshake or listener was started.
Certificate rotation, client authentication, hostname validation, and production ingress remain open.
